name: Hawaii
status_why: The Office's summary text file answered scripts.
system: Hawaii Office of Elections' own results: printout readouts posted as text and PDF files (WordPress site behind Cloudflare; older years on files.hawaii.gov)

results_page.label: Hawaii Office of Elections: election results

election.how_to_find: Watch the results page for the 2026 General folder.

feeds.address: https://elections.hawaii.gov/wp-content/results/<YYYY> <Primary|General>/summary.txt (tab-separated, '#FormatVersion 1': contest, candidate, Mail Votes, In-Person Votes, Total Votes, precincts counted); precinct detail media.txt in the same folder; PDFs histatewide.pdf, coh.pdf, com.pdf, cok.pdf, cch.pdf, precinct.pdf, hi_sov.pdf
feeds.updates: readouts through election night (first soon after polls close at 7 p.m. HST), then a final readout
feeds.note: 2026-10-09: the results page and .../2026 Primary/summary.txt (31 KB) answered 200 to the script (Cloudflare server, no challenge). The 2026 General folder is not linked yet; expect '2026 General'.

races_in_feed: Governor, both House seats, legislature, OHA trustees, county mayors and councils, measures: every contest on the ballot (Hawaii's counties have no separate results sites)
local: No: the Office of Elections reports all four counties (Honolulu, Hawaii, Maui, Kauai)
how_counted: Readouts begin after polls close at 7 p.m. Hawaii time, with mail and in-person votes counted apart.
count_order: Mail Votes and In-Person Votes columns for every candidate.
vote_types: Yes: Mail Votes and In-Person Votes columns for every candidate, and blank, over and invalid votes split the same way

certify.rule: After the time for bringing an election contest has passed: 4:30 p.m. on the 20th day after the election (Hawaii Rev. Stat. 11-155, 11-156, 11-174.5).
certify.source: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself

scout_plan: Poll summary.txt in the 2026 General folder every few minutes from 7 p.m. HST (midnight Central): it carries every contest at every level with a mail and in-person split, so one small file covers statewide, Congress and local. Add media.txt for precinct results once the night's readouts settle.
sources: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself
